note: One entry per operational tool. build_tool_catalog.py adds the code facts (blob OID, last commit, GitHub link, source, open PRs touching the file). {hub} in commands is replaced by the hub checkout the page is built from. Edit here, then rebuild; never hand-edit the HTML.

tools.name: Invoke-PrFixInSitu.ps1
tools.goal: Fix one open PR in place: diagnose, check out, merge the base in, test, push to the same branch, then reply to and resolve review threads with proof.
tools.when: A PR is red, conflicting or has open review threads, and you want to fix it on its own branch rather than open a superseding PR.
tools.not_for: Triage across many PRs (Invoke-DraftPrPass). Fork PRs. Branches another session is working (LIVE). Generated-output conflicts (Resolve-RegenConflicts).
tools.writes: Worktree + commits only with -Prepare/-Sync; pushes only with -Publish (never force); replies and resolves threads only with -ResolveThread after a passing -Test on the published head. Diagnose alone is read-only.

tools.name: Invoke-DraftPrPass.ps1
tools.goal: Read-only triage of open PRs: conflicts, red checks, unresolved bot review threads (P0-P3, security) and live sessions; one class per PR.
tools.when: Start of a PR pass, or to pick which PR to fix next. Feeds Invoke-PrFixInSitu.
tools.not_for: Changing anything; it never pushes, comments or resolves.
tools.writes: Read-only. Table plus JSON report in $env:TEMP.

tools.name: Resolve-RegenConflicts.ps1
tools.goal: Clear merge conflicts that sit only in generated, SHA-pinned outputs (launcher.json, JADE pages) by re-running their generators on the merged sources.
tools.when: A PR conflicts with master only in generated files.
tools.not_for: Hand-written source conflicts: resolve those hunk by hunk (runbook section 2).
tools.writes: Merges master into the PR branch, regenerates, commits and pushes (skips LIVE and FORK PRs).
artefacts: merge commit on the PR branch

tools.name: pr_intervention.py
tools.goal: PR intervention ledger: decide stale-branch update vs holdout per PR (slice 1); rerun / debug-rerun via rerun_triage (slice 2).
tools.when: Deciding whether a stale PR should be updated from master or held out.

tools.name: CODE MAROON (census + worker)
tools.goal: Review- and security-debt programme: census of alerts and review threads into roots and lanes; worker plans a Kahn wave of disjoint roots (max 2), fixes, and closes threads only with code_maroon.closure-proof.v1 proofs.
tools.when: Bulk, disjoint fixes of review threads across repos; nightly security census.
tools.not_for: Native Windows: operations.py needs fcntl (Linux, macOS or WSL). On Windows use Invoke-PrFixInSitu, which writes proofs in MAROON's schema.
tools.writes: Private ledger ~/.maroon; worker commits and thread closure only with proof; never merges.

tools.name: fpc_receipt.py
tools.goal: Build and write the FPC_RECEIPT_V1 receipt in a PR body so the first-pass-closure gate can go green.
tools.when: A hub PR is CLEAN except for the first-pass-closure gate.
artefacts: FPC_RECEIPT_V1 block in the PR body

tools.name: preflight_overlap.py
tools.goal: Before building a metric, page or tool: is it already owned on master or in an open PR?
tools.when: Before every new tool or metric (AGENTS.md L4: one owner, import, never copy).
tools.not_for: Proof of absence when its open-PR step fails; then check gh pr list by hand.

tools.name: Invoke-WorkspaceAudit.ps1
tools.goal: Stale GitHub tokens, unpushed branches (PUSH-ME) and reclaimable worktrees/clones (REMOVABLE) on this PC.
tools.when: Weekly, or when C: is tight, or before retiring a thread.
tools.not_for: Deleting anything without -Apply; clone deletion needs -AllowCloneDelete and goes to the Recycle Bin.
tools.writes: Read-only by default; -Apply removes REMOVABLE worktrees without --force.

tools.name: Invoke-WorkspaceOverview.ps1
tools.goal: One read-only view of every repo and worktree on this PC (runs the audit per root, lists Claude worktrees and stale worktree entries).
tools.when: Finding where a branch or worktree lives; before cleanup.

tools.name: Invoke-BranchHygiene.ps1
tools.goal: Remove merged branches across all repos and local clones, lossless only (delete decision owned by scripts/branch_hygiene_delete.py).
tools.not_for: Unmerged or open-PR branches; it skips them with a reason.

tools.name: Set-PyCharmWorkspaceConfig.ps1
tools.goal: Write PyCharm project and IDE settings for the workspace folder built by Invoke-WorkspaceOverview.
tools.when: After rebuilding the PyCharm workspace folder.

tools.name: hv03_custody.py
tools.goal: HV-03 private, read-only worktree custody inventory.
tools.when: Recording which worktree holds what before a handover.

tools.name: build_dashboards.py
tools.goal: PC dashboard launcher: one page linking every HTML page in every local clone, plus pinned dashboards (this catalog is one of them).
tools.when: Finding a dashboard; daily refresh task.

tools.name: build_tool_catalog.py
tools.goal: This page: what each operational tool is for, when to use it, how to run it, what it writes, its code at the exact commit, and the PRs/issues changing it.
tools.when: Choosing a tool; checking which PR changes one; onboarding a session.

tools.name: extract_pasted_content.py
tools.goal: Extract every pasted_content block from a Claude Code session transcript, byte-exact.
tools.when: Recovering a handover paste from a session.

tools.name: build_mermaid_check.py
tools.goal: Render-check Mermaid diagrams from Markdown or .mmd files in a browser.
tools.when: Before merging docs with Mermaid diagrams.
